radiology_report:
Subject: Prostate Multiparametric MRI | Reporting Facility: OLVG Amsterdam | Date: 10 January 2025

Clinical context involves monitoring a PSA reading of 27.0 ng/mL alongside a previously positive biopsy, with screening imaging currently assigned a PI-RADS 5 classification.

FINDINGS:
Prostatic volume registers at 58.78 mL. T2-weighted sequences highlight a discrete, hypointense focus measuring roughly 22 mm within the left mid-gland posterior peripheral zone. Diffusion-weighted imaging exhibits pronounced signal restriction paired with correspondingly depressed ADC values. Post-contrast dynamics show rapid, focal enhancement confined to the lesion. No signs of extraprostatic spread or seminal vesicle infiltration are noted. Pelvic lymph nodes appear normal in both size and structure.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 5 lesion in the left mid-gland peripheral zone.
PSA density: 0.459 ng/mL/mL.
csPCa predicted probability 0.8667895.

previous_notes.text: A PSA reading of 19.9 ng/mL was recorded on 25 January 2023 during initial screening. This prompted a urological referral, leading to a systematic biopsy that ultimately revealed a Gleason 3+4 diagnosis.
